_readme: Copy this file to reviewers.local.json in the same directory and replace the
addresses with the real ones. reviewers.local.json is gitignored (**/*.local.json);
this example is committed, so every address in it is deliberately fake.
Keys are the `id` of a reviewer in lib/email/newsletter-reviewers.ts. A person can
hold more than one address — Mahsa holds two (one organisational, one academic) and
so does Sara — and the round goes to all of them, counted as ONE person.
Every reviewer marked `newsletterReviewer: true` in the committed roster MUST have
at least one address here: mahsa, lesley, tharaneetharan, chan. A reviewer with none
makes the round REFUSE by name rather than send to whoever it could resolve.
The marketing and events entries are optional — they are not on the newsletter
round — but filling them in now means a future marketing send needs no new setup.
